item.title: First-half goals lead Davidstown-Courtnacuddy past Clane to Leinster club JHC crown
item.description: Three first-half goals helped propel Davidstown-Courtnacuddy (Wexford) to a 3-12 to 0-11 victory over Clane (Kildare) in Hawkfield this afternoon as they claimed the Leinster club junior hurling championship title.

item.title: Watch: Kilkenny legend Hogan helps Danesfort to Leinster glory with late goal off the bench
item.description: Danesfort (Kilkenny) captured the Leinster club intermediate hurling championship title with a 2-15 to 0-12 win against Ratoath (Meath) at Pairc Tailteann this afternoon.

item.title: Watch: Late drama as Geaney's two-point free snatches Munster club SFC crown for Dingle
item.description: Dingle triumphed to their first Munster club senior football championship title after edging out St Finbarr's in Thurles this afternoon.

item.title: Sunday's provincial club championship final results
item.description: Here are this afternoon's provincial club football and hurling championship final results...

item.title: Murnaghan takes charge of Allenwood
item.description: Kildare club Allenwood have appointed Mark Murnaghan as their new senior football manager.

item.title: GAA president praised for 'lovely gesture'
item.description: Nigel Dunne has praised GAA president Jarlath Burns for his 'lovely gesture' following his retirement from Offaly duty.

item.title: Ballymac win Munster final in new jerseys commemorating late team-mate
item.description: Ballymacelligott honoured their late team-mate Luke Silles' memory by wearing a new set of jerseys sponsored by his parents, Tony and Paula, in conjunction with the Ballygarry Estate Hotel & Spa, in last Saturday's Munster club JFC final.

item.title: 'That's the way it goes'
item.description: A typically gracious Jimmy Barry Murphy had no gripe with the match officials after St Finbarr's lost the Munster club SFC final to a contentious free in the dying seconds.

item.title: Louth veteran Duffy goes out on a high
item.description: Bevan Duffy has called time on his 13-year inter-county football career with Louth.

item.title: Dingle delight tempered by O'Connor's likely unavailability for 'Boden clash
item.description: Newly-crowned Munster club football champions Dingle are resigned to being without Mark O'Connor for their All-Ireland semi-final meeting with Ballyboden St Enda's early in the New Year.
